Default markdown output format produces standard markdown

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Title</h1><p>Some text.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(heading_style: 'Atx', output_format: 'Markdown'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
